items.id: Tunlan hat collision with Dunsom (major in verify2_q/r)
items.evidence: Re-measured with verify2_q's method (median CIELAB of a hat crop) on an independent capture (_harness/_shots/maxunits/v3q_A, seed and scene different from the engineer's): Tunlan hat L 84.7 C 28.1 h 74, Dunsom hat L 78.1 C 24.6 h 315 (and L 77.7 C 23.6 h 318 on a second Dunsom), Vashil hood L 70.9 C 18.3 h 315. dE76 Tunlan-Dunsom 46.0 / 44.4, Tunlan-Vashil 42.5, above the >= 25 bar. By eye the straw disc with a plum octagonal crown no longer reads like Dunsom's lilac disc. The major is closed.

items.id: U7 crowns on Ervet, Marund, Ardit, Ilsheta, Lisvel, Sukri
items.evidence: The claims exist: zone_grades.json carries the zones, glb_paint_grade.mjs has --cyl, zone_grade.py intersects parts with boxes and cyls, and lineup_qa.py has crown metrics. In-game crops (v3q_A/B and r2f_u7_gamecam_ab.png) show a mint/teal Marund dome, a periwinkle Ardit helm, magenta Ervet pauldrons and crest, a green Ilsheta hood, a cyan Lisvel wrap and a lemon Sukri hood. Each now differs in hue family from the cream of round 1. Texture dimensions are identical to verify2's head (f4db1c56d) for all 8 re-graded GLBs, so memory is neutral. GLBs are 1138-1161 KiB, under 1172.

I measured zone_grade.reserved_pct on the shipped _base albedo: harm tunlan 3.52, ervet 1.52, marund 4.74, ardit 0.92, ilsheta 0.02, lisvel 0.20, sukri 7.60, burdam 6.63, kemdo 4.45, vashil 0.05, rishal 0.28 (tritanAltRose 6.56). Ally <= 0.23 and heal <= 0.07 everywhere. Every result is <= 8 %, matching the claim. Sukri sits at 7.6 of 8.
r2f_u7_lineup_post_b.json reads 16.9 -> 21.2, inside 20-35. The hood and mask are untouched, and the GLB is 1159.3 KiB.

creatures_b.py line 1885 has the 38-degree tip, and build_report_sunsplinter.json gives 8224 tris (+6). In my seed 7 t 400 shot the tip slab sits behind the orb, so the orb reads clear. The unitPx claim does NOT reproduce on this machine: my value_probe RIFT High t 400 reads seed 7 43,767 (claim 72,667), seed 19 29,511 (claim 52,825) and seed 31 28,404. All three are under the 51,944 gate. The machine was at load ~200, and fighters were fighting in the pit, so this may be a sim-state or scheduling difference, not the GLB. I cannot confirm the gate margin.

I ran npm run -s build, then perf_1080 --prod --no-build --q high,ultra --no-dyn --no-mem --no-gpubound --match-seeds 11 through the heavy queue. Result: High 210k tris / 149 draws / 39 programs, Ultra 217k / 149 / 39. Match seed 11 peaks at 454k tris, 286 draws, 40 programs, with 0 programs first seen after 1:00. GATE PASS. Frame timing was not measured (load 195-220) and is owed to the idle gate. probe_match_memory was not re-run, because texture dimensions and counts are unchanged.

npm run -s typecheck passes. content:check: 0 warnings. npm run -s probe: 54 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. probe_sim_buildplan skipped once on a concurrent content-build race, then passed alone (15/0). value_probe fighterTop25 in game is 80.6-81.0, inside 70-85, on seeds 7, 19 and 31.
These are albedo-only changes with no geometry change to hoods or heads. No new conical or pointed shape and no face change. The hue families are VALE's own, with nothing copied.

problems.what: The lane is still below par against the LoL gauge, and this major carries over from verify2. The crowns are now colour breaks on unchanged low-detail heads, and no fighter has head modelling. U6 glass and U1(2) ORM bands are still invisible at 28.5 m and are left to the lead. Odrum, Ulkro, Hesmi and Nurrow crowns are unchanged, and Burdam still leads with a cream hood and pack (cards lane).
problems.evidence: The engineer's own notDone list, the v3q_A/B crops, and r2f_u7_gamecam_ab.png. Most crowns miss lineup_qa's own break bar (dL >= 8 or dHue >= 20): only Tunlan, Ilsheta and Burdam meet it at facing 0. Marund sigPct is 5.5 / 3.3, under 6.
problems.fix: Model the heads (U7 spec) on at least the cream-headed fighters. The lead should rule on U6 and on the ruling 32 scope over unzoned bakes (Odrum, Sukri). Then re-gauge.

problems.what: Value-hierarchy regression from the crown zones under lineup_qa lighting. Tunlan's top band flips from pass to fail against the bible's 'Top quarter L* 70-85' (72.1/70.1 -> 62.4/58.5; valueGradientOk true -> false; this one was disclosed). Ardit's gradient inverts at facing 0 (top 61.9 -> 53.9, below mid 55.5; valueGradientMonotone true -> false), which was not disclosed. Ervet (58.7 -> 50.9, 56.5 -> 48.8) and Ilsheta (67.9 -> 62.6) move further below 70.
problems.evidence: r2f_u7_lineup_pre.json against r2f_u7_lineup_post / post_b / post_c.json, fighters[].facings[].valueBands, valueGradientOk and valueGradientMonotone. The in-game fighterTop25 still passes (80.6-81), so this is a lineup and bible-spec regression, not a gameplay-camera one.
problems.fix: Lift Ardit's helm and Ervet's gunmetal toward L* 50+ (or move the crown break onto hue at a lighter value) until top > mid at both facings. Report Tunlan's top band to the lead with the round-1 value.

problems.what: The Sunsplinter unitPx gate is not reproducible, and the claimed thin margin could not be confirmed.
problems.evidence: value_probe RIFT High t 400 on this run: seed 7 43,767, seed 19 29,511, seed 31 28,404, all under the gate of 51,944. The engineer reports 72,667 and 52,825 on the same seeds. This run had load ~200, and seed 19 also failed the env lane's walkableSpread (47 > 45, not this lane).
problems.fix: Re-measure at the idle gate with --monsters only on seeds 7 and 19. If it is still under, make the orb or crown larger, or have the lead re-base the gate as a Longshade ratio measured in the same run.

problems.what: Cross-lane: the cards for every fighter whose GLB albedo changed this round now show the pre-zoning colours. Cards render from the cached .blend unless --glb-albedo is used. So the card on-model palette check (ruling 30) is stale for Tunlan, Ervet, Marund, Ardit, Ilsheta, Lisvel, Sukri and Burdam.
problems.evidence: portraits.py _glb_albedo docstring (verify_r2_g2a 'stale vs rebuilt GLB'). Cards lane builds with --glb-albedo were running in the heavy queue during this check (rishal, hesmi).
problems.fix: The cards lane re-renders those fighters' base cards with --glb-albedo and re-runs card_qa. The units lane flags the GLB list in its summary.

budgets: perf_1080 --prod (fresh npm run -s build, heavy queue, --q high,ultra --no-dyn --no-mem --no-gpubound --match-seeds 11): High 210k/149/39, Ultra 217k/149/39, match seed 11 peak 454k tris / 286 draws / 40 programs, GATE PASS; timing not measured (load ~200). Texture sizes identical to f4db1c56d for all re-graded GLBs, so match memory is neutral (probe_match_memory not re-run). Largest fighter GLB is lisvel at 1161.3 KiB (<= 1172).
